SBI Assistant Manager Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 17 Posts
Last Updated: 04 November 2026
Latest Update: Updated
Author: Govt Job Guru Team
SBI Assistant Manager Engineer Fire Online Form 2026: The State Bank of India has published the recruitment notification (Advt No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/29) on its official website. https://sbi.bank.in (opens in new tab) The notification is for the recruitment of 17 Assistant Manager - Engineer (Fire) posts. The last date to apply for these vacancies is 25/11/2026. Candidates who have B.E. (Fire) from National Fire Service College (NFSC) Nagpur OR B.E/B.Tech (Safety & Fire Engineering) OR B.E/B.Tech (Fire Technology & Safety Engineering) OR Equivalent 4-year degree in Fire Safety from UGC recognized University/AICTE approved institution OR Graduate member of Institution of Fire Engineers (India/UK) OR Divisional Officers course from NFSC, Nagpur qualifications can apply Apply Online for SBI Assistant Manager Engineer Recruitment 2026. Interested candidates must read the official notification carefully and complete the application process as per the given instructions. The official website link and the SBI Assistant Manager Engineer Recruitment 2026 notification link are provided below under the heading Important Links.

Vacancies Detail
Here, you can find the position wise vacancies detail of each position open under SBI Assistant Manager Engineer Recruitment 2026 notification. You can find here the number of vacancies, qualification, age limit and pay scale. The complete eligibility criteria of each position open under SBI is given below.

Assistant Manager - Engineer (Fire)
No. of Vacancies: 17 (SC-2, ST-2 [including 1 backlog], OBC-1, EWS-1, UR-11)
Qualification: B.E. (Fire) from NFSC Nagpur OR B.E/B.Tech (Safety & Fire Engineering) OR B.E/B.Tech (Fire Technology & Safety Engineering) OR Equivalent 4-year degree in Fire Safety from UGC recognized University/AICTE approved institution OR Graduate member of Institution of Fire Engineers (India/UK) OR Divisional Officers course from NFSC, Nagpur; with minimum 2 years composite experience in fire safety (for degree holders) OR minimum 3 years experience as Station Officer or equivalent (for Graduate member IFE/DO course holders)
Age Limit: Minimum: 21 Years, Maximum: 40 Years (as on 31.10.2026)
Pay Scale: Rs. 48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920 (JMGS-I)
Selection Procedure
The detailed selection procedure has been mentioned in the official notification of SBI Assistant Manager Engineer Recruitment 2026. But we are giving you here the short summary of the selection procedure. The candidates are advised to refer to official notification for selection procedure.

Selection Procedure:

Online Written Test (Objective Type):
English Language: 50 Questions, 50 Marks, 40 Minutes
Professional Knowledge: 75 Questions, 75 Marks, 80 Minutes
Total: 125 Questions, 125 Marks, 2 Hours
No penalty for wrong answers
Professional Knowledge covers: Fire Engineering, Fire Service Administration, Fire Service Regulatory Acts/By-laws
Interview:
Carries 100 marks
Qualifying marks decided by the Bank
Category-wise adequate number of candidates qualifying in online test will be called for interview
Merit List:
Written Test (Objective): Normalized to 70 marks (out of 125)
Interview: Normalized to 30 marks (out of 100)
Total Normalized Score: 100 marks
Category-wise merit list drawn in descending order of normalized score
Tie-breaking: Candidates with same cut-off marks ranked by age in descending order

How to Apply
Here is the complete procedure to apply for SBI Assistant Manager Engineer Recruitment 2026. The candidates should read the complete procedure to apply in the official notification from the links given below.

The application procedure for is not fully online. Candidates are advised to follow the detailed instructions given below.

Visit SBI’s official website: https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings
Scroll down and click on advertisement no. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/29
Download and carefully read the detailed advertisement
Register online by filling in the application form with all required details
Upload all required documents: recent photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression, brief resume, ID proof, proof of date of birth, caste certificate (if applicable), educational certificates, experience certificates, Form-16/Offer Letter/Latest Salary slip, NOC (if applicable), and hand-written declaration
Pay the application fee online using Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card etc.
After successful payment, an e-receipt and application form will be generated; print and retain for future reference
Take a printout of the system generated online application form after completing registration

Other Important Information
Other Important Information:

Grade/Scale: JMGS-I (Junior Management Grade Scale – I)
Probation Period: 06 Months
Posting: Anywhere in India; Bank reserves right to transfer officers to any office of SBI in India or depute to associates/subsidiaries
Perquisites: DA, HRA, CCA, Provident Fund, NPS (Contributory Pension Fund), Leave Fare Concession (LFC), Medical Facility, and other perquisites as per rules
Job Profile: Improve fire safety arrangements at branches/offices, carry out branch visits, organize periodic fire drills, lectures, maintain liaison with Govt agencies
Key Responsibility Areas: Fire safety audits, vetting engineering drawings, preparing fire orders, organizing fire drills, liaison with Govt agencies, obtaining Fire NOC, conducting firefighting training
Specific Skills Required: Knowledge of Fire prevention and protection systems (Fire Pumps, Fire Hydrant System, Fire Detection & Alarm System, Fire Sprinkler System), building evacuation procedure, and Fire Safety Audit
Age Relaxation: Available to reserved category candidates as per Govt. of India guidelines; cumulative age relaxation not available
OBC Candidates: OBC certificate with Non-Creamy Layer clause must be issued during 01.04.2026 to date of interview; Creamy Layer candidates must apply as Unreserved
EWS Candidates: Income & Asset Certificate for FY 2025-26 required; valid for 2026-27
Documents Required: Resume, ID proof, age proof, caste certificate (if applicable), OBC certificate (Non-Creamy Layer), educational qualification, experience certificates, Form-16/Offer Letter/Latest Salary slip, NOC (if applicable), hand-written declaration
Biometric/IRIS Verification: Bank may capture IRIS scan/thumb impression at various stages for verification
Travel Reimbursement for Interview: Outstation candidates reimbursed economy class airfare (shortest route), maximum Rs. 10,000 (to-and-fro) or actual travel cost, whichever is lower; local transportation not reimbursed
Examination Centres: Online examination conducted across multiple centres in India (see Annexure I)
Legal Jurisdiction: Mumbai courts/tribunals have sole and exclusive jurisdiction for any disputes
Bank’s Right: Bank reserves right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage without assigning any reasons

The following questions are related to SBI Assistant Manager Engineer Recruitment 2026 that have been answered to help candidates clear their doubts quickly before applying.

Q1. What is SBI Assistant Manager Engineer Recruitment 2026 notification for?
SBI Assistant Manager Engineer Recruitment 2026 notification is for the recruitment of Assistant Manager - Engineer (Fire) posts. There are total 17 vacancies available as per the notification.

Q2. Who is eligible to apply for this recruitment?
Anyone is eligible who has completed B.E. (Fire) from National Fire Service College (NFSC) Nagpur OR B.E/B.Tech (Safety & Fire Engineering) OR B.E/B.Tech (Fire Technology & Safety Engineering) OR Equivalent 4-year degree in Fire Safety from UGC recognized University/AICTE approved institution OR Graduate member of Institution of Fire Engineers (India/UK) OR Divisional Officers course from NFSC, Nagpur and fulfills the other requirements stated in the official notification.

Q3. What is the application procedure?
The application process for this recruitment is Apply Online.

Q4. Where can candidates find official updates?
Candidates are advised to check the official website and the Important Links section above for official updates and notifications. The official website of SBI is https://sbi.bank.in (opens in new tab).

Q5. Is reading the official notification required?
Yes, it is necessary to read the official notification to understand the details, terms and conditions, and instructions before applying.
